newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Lithuanian shares mixed, dealers cautious.
newsitem.headline: Lithuanian shares mixed, dealers cautious.

text.p: *The official index inched up 1.44 points to 921.44.
*Group A shares down 16.18 points to 2,008.74 points.
Brokers were cautiously optimistic despite mixed results from share indices Tuesday and pointed to increased activity as a sign Lithuania's stock exchange may be shaking off the doldrums.
"Compared to last week, it's looking a little bit more active," said Saulius Merkys, a broker with Vilfima.
"I think a majority of the brokers expect prices to go up," said Tomas Andrejauskas, a broker with Suprema. "The market has stabilised and more prices are going up than down."
Group A shares were down 16.18 points to 2,008.74. The official index inched up 1.44 points to 921.44 and the Litin G index rose 12.04 points to 1836.30 points.
Hermis Bank was unchanged at 180.00 litas but saw 140,000 litas turnover on the central market.
Savings Bank shares slid to 260.00 litas from 268.00 litas amid 104,000 litas turnover.
"It's difficult to say why Savings Bank is falling," said Andrejauskas."
